Method of Attack: Brute force attack on query ID and port
Exploitation of ICMP response rate limits
Impacted Systems: Linux distributions including Redhat, Debian, Suse, Ubuntu, RHEL 7, CentOS 7, CloudLinux 7, Oracle Enterprise Linux 7
Attack Vector: ICMP error messages to infer open ports
Flooding recursive DNS servers with spoofed responses
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious IP addresses resolving for targeted domains
